# Setup

Fit and tune Eastern oyster MaxEnt models with ENMeval and maxnet. Use ENMeval's native spatial block partitions, then map the selected model on the cloglog scale. The final section saves the model, tables, raster, and suitability maps when this workflow is run.

```{r}
#| label: model-setup

library(ENMeval)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(maxnet)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tmap)

#here::i_am("3-scripts/5-model-eval.qmd")
set.seed(42)

raster_directory <- here::here("2-data", "rasters")
model_directory <- here::here("2-data", "models")
table_directory <- here::here("4-tables-and-figures", "tables")
map_directory <- here::here("4-tables-and-figures", "maps")

tune_settings <- list(
  fc = c("L", "LQ", "LQH", "LQHP"),
  rm = c(0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4)
)

n_background <- 10000L

k_folds <- 4L
block_orientation <- "lat_lon"
prediction_type <- "cloglog"
```

# Environmental predictors

Keep cells with finite values for every predictor. Sediment is converted to a categorical predictor after the numeric coverage checks.

```{r}
#| label: environmental-predictors

predictor_files <- c(
  #Depth = "rast_depth.tif",
  Dissolved.Oxygen = "rast_do.tif",
  Salinity = "rast_sal.tif",
  Sediment = "rast_sed.tif",
  Turbidity = "rast_turb.tif",
  Water.Temperature = "rast_wTemp.tif",
  Oyster.Recruitment = "rast_oys_rec.tif"
)

predictors <- terra::rast(
  file.path(raster_directory, predictor_files)
)
names(predictors) <- names(predictor_files)

valid_layers <- terra::app(is.finite(predictors), "sum")
complete_mask <- terra::ifel(
  valid_layers == terra::nlyr(predictors),
  1,
  NA
)

# save mask for later use



predictors <- terra::mask(predictors, complete_mask)
```

# Presence and background points

Thin oyster occurrences to 1 km, remove points without complete predictor values, and retain one occurrence per raster cell. Sample 5,000 background points from other complete cells.

```{r}
#| label: prepare-model-points

occ_sf <- readRDS(
  here::here("2-data", "processed", "proc_oys_reefs.rds")
) %>%
  sf::st_transform(crs = 4326) %>%
  mutate(
    lon = sf::st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
    lat = sf::st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2]
  ) %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  GeoThinneR::thin_points(
    lon_col = "lon",
    lat_col = "lat",
    method = "distance",
    thin_dist = 1,
    seed = 42
  ) %>%
  GeoThinneR::largest() %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

occ_sf <- sf::st_transform(
  occ_sf,
  terra::crs(predictors)
)

occ_xy <- as.data.frame(
  sf::st_coordinates(occ_sf)[, 1:2]
)

names(occ_xy) <- c("x", "y")

# Remove points with missing predictors
occ_values <- terra::extract(
  predictors,
  as.matrix(occ_xy)
)

valid_occ <- rowSums(
  is.finite(as.matrix(occ_values))
) == terra::nlyr(predictors)

occ_xy <- occ_xy[valid_occ, , drop = FALSE]

# Remove raster-cell duplicates
occ_cells <- terra::cellFromXY(
  predictors[[1]],
  as.matrix(occ_xy)
)

occ_xy <- occ_xy[
  !duplicated(occ_cells),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

rownames(occ_xy) <- NULL

cat("Valid occurrences:", nrow(occ_xy), "\n")

bg_candidates <- terra::spatSample(
  complete_mask,
  size = n_background + nrow(occ_xy),
  method = "random",
  na.rm = TRUE,
  values = FALSE,
  xy = TRUE,
  as.df = TRUE
)

bg_xy <- as.data.frame(bg_candidates[, 1:2])
names(bg_xy) <- c("x", "y")

bg_cells <- terra::cellFromXY(
  complete_mask,
  as.matrix(bg_xy)
)

presence_cells <- terra::cellFromXY(
  complete_mask,
  as.matrix(occ_xy)
)

bg_xy <- bg_xy[
  !bg_cells %in% presence_cells,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

bg_xy <- head(bg_xy, n_background)
rownames(bg_xy) <- NULL

cat("Background points:", nrow(bg_xy), "\n")

n_occ <- nrow(occ_xy)
n_bg <- nrow(bg_xy)

if (n_occ < 2L * k_folds || n_bg < n_background) {
  stop("Too few valid occurrences or complete background cells. Review the inputs.")
}

pb_data <- bind_rows(
  mutate(occ_xy, pb = 1L),
  mutate(bg_xy, pb = 0L)
)

pb <- sf::st_as_sf(
  pb_data,
  coords = c("x", "y"),
  crs = terra::crs(predictors)
) %>%
  mutate(point_type = ifelse(pb == 1L, "Presence", "Background"))

study_area <- readRDS(
  here::here("2-data", "processed", "study_area.rds")
) %>%
  sf::st_transform(crs = sf::st_crs(pb))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-maxent-points
#| fig-cap: "Eastern oyster presence and background points used in the MaxEnt model."

tmap::tmap_mode("plot")

point_map <- tm_shape(complete_mask) +
  tm_raster(
    col.scale = tm_scale(values = "grey90"),
    col.legend = tm_legend_hide()
  ) +

    ),

    size = 0.05
  ) +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE)

point_map
```

# Spatial cross-validation

ENMeval's block method divides occurrences into four geographic groups using northing, then easting, with background points assigned to the same regions. These are four geographic partitions rather than five folds assembled from fixed 5 km blocks.

```{r}
#| label: spatial-partitions

# partition_groups <- blockCV::cv_spatial(
#         x = pb,
#         column = "pb",
#         r = complete_mask,
#         k = 5,
#         size = 5000,
#         selection = "random",
#         presence_bg = TRUE,
#         seed = 42,
#         plot = FALSE
# )

# fold_ids <- partition_groups$folds_ids

# user_groups <- list(
#   occs.grp = partition_groups$folds_ids[pb$pb == 1L],
#   bg.grp = partition_groups$folds_ids[pb$pb == 0L]
# )

partition_groups <- ENMeval::get.block(
  occs = occ_xy,
  bg = bg_xy,
  orientation = block_orientation
)

fold_ids <- c(
  partition_groups$occs.grp,
  partition_groups$bg.grp
)

fold_summary <- pb_data %>%
  mutate(fold = fold_ids) %>%
  group_by(fold) %>%
  summarise(
    presence = sum(pb == 1L),
    background = sum(pb == 0L),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(fold_summary)

fold_plot <- ggplot(
  pb_data %>% mutate(fold = factor(fold_ids)),
  aes(x = x, y = y)
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = fold, shape = factor(pb)),
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 1.2
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Spatial CV partitions",
    color = "Fold",
    shape = "Presence"
  )

print(fold_plot)
```

# Tune and evaluate MaxEnt models

Compare all feature-class and regularization settings using the four spatial partitions. Validation AUC compares held-out presences with background points in the held-out region. Omission uses the 10th percentile of training presence scores.

```{r}
#| label: tune-maxent

# Sediment codes represent categories, not a continuous measurement.
predictors[["Sediment"]] <- as.factor(predictors[["Sediment"]])

e.mx <- ENMeval::ENMevaluate(
  occs = occ_xy,
  envs = predictors,
  bg = bg_xy,
  algorithm = "maxnet",
  categoricals = "Sediment",
  #partitions = "user",
  #user.grp = user_groups,
  partitions = "block",
  partition.settings = list(orientation = block_orientation),
  tune.args = tune_settings,
  other.settings = list(
    validation.bg = "partition",
    pred.type = prediction_type
  ),
  raster.preds = FALSE,
  parallel = FALSE,
  # Populate metadata without loading an external template.
  rmm = list(),
  quiet = FALSE
)

results <- tibble::as_tibble(ENMeval::eval.results(e.mx))
partition_results <- tibble::as_tibble(
  ENMeval::eval.results.partitions(e.mx)
)

ranked_models <- results %>%
  arrange(delta.AICc)

print(
  ranked_models %>%
    select(
      any_of(c(
        "fc", "rm", "tune.args", "auc.val.avg", "auc.val.sd",
        "auc.diff.avg", "cbi.val.avg", "or.10p.avg",
        "AICc", "delta.AICc", "ncoef"
      ))
    ),
  n = Inf
)
```

# Select the final model

Retain models within two AICc units of the minimum when available, then rank by validation omission, AUC, and model complexity. These are tuning results from the same folds used to choose the model.

sequential method that uses cross-validation results by selecting models with the lowest average 10 percentile omission rate, and to break ties, with the highest average validation Continuous Boyce Index (Hirzel et al. 2006) calculated with the function from the R package ecospat (Di Cola et al. 2017).

```{r}
#| label: select-final-model
#| 
res <- eval.results(e.mx)

# first removes settings with NA values for omission rate.
# Select the model with delta AICc equal to 0, or the one with the lowest AICc score.

opt.seq <- res %>%
  filter(!is.na(or.10p.avg)) %>%
  filter(or.10p.avg == min(or.10p.avg)) %>%
  filter(cbi.val.avg == max(cbi.val.avg))

model_id <- as.character(opt.seq$tune.args[[1]])
mod.seq <- eval.models(e.mx)[[model_id]]

best_model <- opt.seq
final_model <- mod.seq

data <- eval.occs(e.mx)[, names(predictors), drop = FALSE]

curve_vars <- names(data)[
  vapply(names(data), function(variable) {
    is.numeric(data[[variable]]) &&
      any(grepl(variable, names(mod.seq$betas), fixed = TRUE))
  }, logical(1))
]

response_plots <- lapply(curve_vars, function(variable) {
  ENMeval::evalplot.respCurve(
    mod.seq,
    data,
    var = variable,
    type = 2
  )
})

patchwork::wrap_plots(response_plots, ncol = 3)


```

# Evaluation summary

Summarize the selected model's held-out folds using the existing cross-validation table names.

```{r}
#| label: evaluation-summary

fold_metrics <- partition_results %>%
  filter(as.character(tune.args) == model_id) %>%
  mutate(fold = as.integer(fold)) %>%
  left_join(fold_summary, by = "fold") %>%
  transmute(
    fold,
    training_presences = n_occ - presence,
    testing_presences = presence,
    training_background = n_bg - background,
    testing_background = background,
    test_auc = auc.val,
    test_omission_10pct = or.10p
  ) %>%
  arrange(fold)

stopifnot(
  nrow(fold_metrics) == k_folds,
  all(is.finite(fold_metrics$test_auc)),
  all(is.finite(fold_metrics$test_omission_10pct))
)

metric_summary <- fold_metrics %>%
  summarise(
    folds = n(),
    mean_test_auc = mean(test_auc),
    sd_test_auc = stats::sd(test_auc),
    mean_test_omission_10pct = mean(test_omission_10pct),
    sd_test_omission_10pct = stats::sd(test_omission_10pct)
  )

knitr::kable(
  metric_summary,
  digits = 3,
  col.names = c(
    "Folds", "Mean AUC", "SD of AUC", "Mean omission", "SD of omission"
  ),
  caption = "Selected MaxEnt model spatial cross-validation results."
)
```

# Tuning diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: tuning-diagnostics

plot_auc <- ggplot(
  results,
  aes(
    x = rm,
    y = auc.val.avg,
    color = fc,
    group = fc
  )
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Validation AUC",
    x = "Regularization multiplier",
    y = "Mean validation AUC",
    color = "Feature class"
  )

plot_omission <- ggplot(
  results,
  aes(
    x = rm,
    y = or.10p.avg,
    color = fc,
    group = fc
  )
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Validation Omission at the 10% Training Threshold",
    x = "Regularization multiplier",
    y = "Mean validation omission",
    color = "Feature class"
  )

plot_aicc <- ggplot(
  results,
  aes(
    x = rm,
    y = delta.AICc,
    color = fc,
    group = fc
  )
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 2,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Model Complexity",
    x = "Regularization multiplier",
    y = "Delta AICc",
    color = "Feature class"
  )

print(plot_auc)
print(plot_omission)
print(plot_aicc)
```


# Predict habitat suitability

Predict the selected model on the same cloglog scale used during evaluation. Restrict predictions to cells with complete predictor coverage.

```{r}
#| label: predict-suitability

# maxent_suitability <- terra::predict(

#     data <- as.data.frame(data)

#     )
#   },
#   type = prediction_type,
#   na.rm = TRUE
# )

maxent_suitability <- ENMeval::maxnet.predictRaster(
  mod = mod.seq,
  envs = predictors,
  pred.type = "cloglog"
)

terra::crs(maxent_suitability) <- terra::crs(predictors)

names(maxent_suitability) <- "oyster_suitability"

```

## Compare model to Null Model

```{r}
# run null sim with 100 iterations for reasonable null dist

null_model <- ENMeval::ENMnulls(e.mx, list(fc = "LQH", rm = 3), no.iter = 100)


```


```{r}
#| label: final-model-equation

b <- mod.seq$betas
intercept <- mod.seq$alpha + mod.seq$entropy

equation <- paste0(
  "eta = ", signif(intercept, 6), " ",
  paste(
    sprintf("%+.6g * [%s]", b, names(b)),
    collapse = " "
  )
)

cat(
  equation,
  "\nSuitability = 1 / (1 + exp(-eta))\n"
)


```

# Save outputs

 saves the final model, raster, selected-model cross-validation tables, and both suitability maps. It also saves the full tuning results and selected settings in the tables directory. The saved model is a maxnet object.

```{r}
#| label: save-model-outputs

for (directory in c(
  model_directory, raster_directory, table_directory, map_directory
)) {
  dir.create(directory, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

saveRDS(
  final_model,
  file.path(model_directory, "maxent_final_model.rds")
)

terra::writeRaster(
  maxent_suitability,
  file.path(raster_directory, "maxent_suitability.tif"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)
terra::writeRaster(
  complete_mask,
  file.path(raster_directory, "complete_mask.tif"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

readr::write_csv(
  fold_metrics,
  file.path(table_directory, "maxent_cross_validation_metrics.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  metric_summary,
  file.path(table_directory, "maxent_cross_validation_summary.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  ranked_models,
  file.path(table_directory, "maxent_tuning_results.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  partition_results,
  file.path(table_directory, "maxent_tuning_partition_metrics.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  best_model,
  file.path(table_directory, "maxent_selected_settings.csv")
)

tmap::tmap_save(
  p_map,
  file.path(map_directory, "Suitability_Map.png")
)
tmap::tmap_save(
  p_map_classified,
  file.path(map_directory, "Suitability_Map_Classified.png")
)
```
